extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and as the Web Store listing title. The brand stays untranslated: users search for 'Moises'.

extDescription.message: Keyboard shortcuts for Moises.ai stem player — mute/solo any track with a single keypress
extDescription.description: Manifest description. Doubles as the Web Store listing summary; max 132 characters.

popupStatusActive.message: Active on this player — press a key
popupStatusActive.description: Popup status when the active tab is the Moises player.

popupStatusWaiting.description: Popup status when the active tab is not the Moises player; followed by the open-player link.

popupOpenPlayer.description: Link that opens the Moises player in a new tab.

popupHintTyping.message: Shortcuts pause while you type in a text field.

popupHintPasteSuffix.description: Input-safety hint, rendered after the Ctrl+V keycaps.

popupMute.description: Action label in the shortcut rows. Kept in English across locales — a standard audio term matching the MUTE/SOLO toast chips.

popupSolo.description: Action label in the shortcut rows. Kept in English across locales.

popupFeedback.description: Footer link to the feedback form.

errTrackNotFound.description: In-page error toast suffix, composed as '<track>: <this>'. The track name comes from the player DOM and is not translated.

errContainerNotFound.description: In-page error toast suffix, composed as '<track>: <this>'.

errButtonNotFound.description: In-page error toast suffix, composed as '<track> <action>: <this>'. The action (mute/solo) stays in English, matching the toast chips.

errNoControls.description: In-page error toast shown when the player frame exposes no recognizable track controls — the extension no longer understands this player.

errDetectedLabels.description: Precedes the list of track labels actually found in the player DOM, shown in the diagnostic toast when a lookup misses. The labels themselves come from the player and are never translated.

feedbackDismiss.description: Tooltip on the ✕ that closes the feedback and review pills.

reviewText.description: Lead-in text of the in-player review prompt, shown after a few successful uses.

reportLink.description: Link in the diagnostic toast that opens the feedback form.

cheatsheetTitle.description: Title on the in-player card that surfaces the shortcuts without opening the toolbar popup.

cheatsheetTryPrefix.description: Card teaser, rendered before the keycap: "Try [V] to mute Vocals". The track name comes from config and is not translated.

cheatsheetTrySuffix.description: Card teaser, rendered after the keycap and before the track name.

cheatsheetShowKeys.description: Card action that expands the full shortcut table.

cheatsheetHideKeys.description: Card action that collapses the shortcut table.

cheatsheetNativeTitle.description: Caption above the shortcuts Moises binds natively, listed in the card but never intercepted by the extension.

cheatsheetNativePlayPause.description: Label for the player’s own spacebar shortcut.

cheatsheetRate.description: Short label beside the star row in the card footer; opens the Web Store review page.

cheatsheetRateCta.description: Call to action shown beside the stars when the rating ask has been earned.

cheatsheetFeedback.description: Card footer link to the feedback form.
